messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Auto sector revenue index: 79 (baseline: 100). Foot traffic and sales are somewhat down.
People around you are stressed: Rick Tanner, Angela Wright. The mood is tense.

Patricia Hawkins and Rick Tanner held a two-hour working session that produced an agreed operational framework for the three surviving service lanes — technician transfer targets, throughput capacity estimates, and a shared document both parties are now working from rather than two separate deliverables. Hawkins contacted ASE and learned that group EV certification enrollment for five to eight technicians runs approximately $800 per technician with a six-month timeline, and committed to funding two certifications this quarter while the transfer period keeps those technicians on payroll. She scheduled a market intelligence conversation with Stephanie Morris for next week. She also reached out to Mark Thompson directly with a specific offer: three apprenticeship placements per year across the surviving service locations for graduates of the Millfield Auto Tech Pipeline — a concrete commitment delivered the same week the board voted yes on the program, positioning Regional Auto Group as an early institutional partner rather than a late-arriving opportunist.
